svg.title: Same program, different supervision
svg.desc: With one coach per 5 people, bench press 1RM rose 15.9 per cent and knee extensor strength 11.8 per cent; with one coach per 25 people, bench press rose 10.2 per cent and knee extensors showed no significant gain.
